timeline.title: Main fan VR2 trips
timeline.text: Motor protection trips the central exhaust fan. A third of the mine's air is gone for six hours.

timeline.title: Seismic event closes North 560 level
timeline.text: A magnitude 1.6 event on North 560. The level is barricaded until the geotechnical inspection.

timeline.title: Main fan VR2 back in service
Skip hoist stopped: rope inspection finding
timeline.text: The rope inspection finds broken wires. Five hours without hoisting - every bin and ore pass now matters.

timeline.title: NEM forecast: critical peak tomorrow 16:00-19:00
timeline.text: Heat wave in South Australia: the market operator forecasts 1,500 USD/MWh for three hours tomorrow evening.

timeline.title: Three Central loaders down
timeline.text: Two transmission failures and a tyre change: the Central zone loses three of eleven loaders for ten hours.

timeline.title: New stope handed over on Central 560
timeline.text: Development completed a new stope. It is not in the mine plan database yet - only its tags appear.

timeline.title: Discovery: ST_C560_10
Power at 1,500 USD/MWh
timeline.text: Every fan, pump and the hoist now costs twelve times more per hour.

timeline.title: Central loaders back from the workshop
Pump station South 930 fails
timeline.text: A pump seal fails. The sump keeps filling - nobody announced it, the twin sees the level rise.
